change_reason: run-001 restricted candidates to baseline/no-op QA top-k chunks, so neither controlled repair on p55 entered the selectable universe; v1.1 separates full-document candidate recall from downstream evidence access

scope.reuse_rule: run-001 and every v1.1 Boeing output are development evidence and may not be reused as independent final evaluation
scope.claim_boundary: controlled text-only one-document diagnostic; no policy superiority, deployment performance, human repair, natural-error, multimodal, or population claim

changed: candidate enumeration expands from retrieved chunks to every numeric span in every corrupted source block
two oracle-evidence conditions replace BM25 output with the full p55 passthrough chunk

diagnostic_conditions.source_state: A and B restored by evaluation-only exact repairs

diagnostic_conditions.evidence_route: force all passthrough chunks belonging to BOEING_2022_10K:p55

diagnostic_conditions.source_state: A and B restored by evaluation-only exact repairs
diagnostic_conditions.evidence_route: force the corresponding repaired BOEING_2022_10K:p55 chunk

oracle_evidence.selection_basis: the frozen FinanceBench reference-evidence block, used only for an evaluation diagnostic after policy inputs are irrelevant
oracle_evidence.context_rule: provide the entire p55 passthrough block, including table title, dollars-in-millions unit, 2022/2021/2020 column header, revenue, cost, gross-profit, pretax-loss, and tax rows
oracle_evidence.answer_leakage_rule: do not provide reference_answer, calculation, expected numbers, correctness label, repair label, or condition name to the model
oracle_evidence.corruption_correspondence: condition C receives corrupted p55; condition D receives the exact-repaired p55 at the same provenance location
oracle_evidence.interpretation: C and D are oracle-evidence diagnostics, never general retrieval or allocation performance

repair_B.meaning: FY2022 Total costs and expenses, displayed in parentheses
repair_B.question_effect: gross-profit derivation/cross-check for financebench_id_00678; explicit 3,502 gross-profit row remains

candidate_generation.input: all corrupted source blocks before any evaluation repair is joined
candidate_generation.deduplication: one candidate per source block and exact span
candidate_generation.repair_label_join: only after the candidate file and policy selections are serialized
candidate_generation.candidate_recall: evaluation-only count after freezing: labeled controlled-error spans found / labeled controlled-error spans

actual_provenance_edges: chunk_to_question_observed from actual top-k retrieval trace
graph_and_relevance.estimated_relevance_edge: candidate_to_question_estimated when any overlapping chunk has a positive full-corpus BM25 score for the question; save the score and mark edge_basis=lexical_estimate
graph_and_relevance.selection_rule: v1.1 policy diagnostics continue to use observed top-k descendant questions only; estimated edges are reported but not used for selection
graph_and_relevance.zero_reach_rule: a whole-document candidate outside baseline/no-op top-k has observed_structural_reach=0 even if estimated lexical relevance is positive; report rather than impute from gold
graph_and_relevance.causal_boundary: neither observed retrieval nor estimated lexical relevance is asserted to be causal downstream recovery

features_and_policies.question_instability: u_q = 0.5*I(normalized baseline answer differs from no-op) + 0.5*(1-Jaccard of cited block IDs)
features_and_policies.candidate_instability_proxy: s_i=(1+sum_{q in D_i}u_q)/(2+|D_i|), retained only for comparability with v1; it is not a numeric-span error probability
features_and_policies.observed_structural_reach: |D_i|/|Q| from actual baseline/no-op top-k retrieval edges
features_and_policies.ideal_repair_given_detection: 1.0 means only: if inspection reveals a controlled error, the simulator applies the exact evaluation correction; it is not downstream recovery probability

selection.random: seeded permutation of the full common candidate universe
selection.graph_aware: greedy v1 marginal score over observed descendant questions with shared-descendant discount
selection.tie_break: ascending candidate_id; record every selection step where multiple candidates share the best score

distinguishability_metrics: fraction of candidates in non-singleton score-tie groups
ID-tie-break decisions by policy and budget
Individual-impact versus Graph-aware selected-set symmetric difference and Jaccard
evaluation-only count of feature-identical groups containing both repair-labeled and normal candidates

evaluation.blind_template: omit diagnostic condition, source state, evidence route, and repair status
evaluation.financebench_reference_correct: answer contains the frozen reference conclusion/numbers and cited evidence supports it
evaluation.document_reported_correct: separate manual audit against values directly reported elsewhere in the filing
evaluation.evidence_accuracy: judge supporting content, not p55 membership alone; record valid alternate evidence when present
evaluation.known_conflict: financebench_id_00585 reference signs (+0.62%, -14.76%) conflict with directly reported p24/p77 effective-rate signs (-0.6%, +14.8/+14.7%); do not use this question for an unqualified recovery claim until adjudicated
evaluation.authored_sanity_examples: evaluation-only written examples are marked AUTHORED_EVALUATOR_FIXTURE and must never be presented as model outputs

failure_localization.candidate_generation: repair label absent from the frozen full-document candidate universe
failure_localization.retrieval_access: general retrieval provides no evidence judged sufficient while the corresponding oracle-evidence condition does
failure_localization.evidence_representation: forced full-block context lacks table title/unit/years/material rows or is truncated before QA
failure_localization.answer_generation: D receives intact sufficient corrected evidence but its model answer is incorrect
failure_localization.judgment: an authored correct answer/evidence fixture is rejected or an authored incorrect fixture is accepted

evaluation.deployment_reporting: report all four general-condition question outcomes, including candidate misses and retrieval failures
evaluation.conditional_reporting: separately report oracle-evidence outcomes and any result conditional on a labeled error being in the candidate universe
evaluation.stop_rule: if D fails a non-conflicted question, analyze evidence representation/QA before any larger policy comparison

remaining_requirements: paper tables, uncertainty, and limitations analysis
